name: Second Coming
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that the Second Coming of Jesus Christ is a future, visible event where He will return in glory, coming with clouds for all to see, including those who pierced Him, causing mourning among the earth's peoples. Believers are exhorted to remain watchful and ready, as the exact timing is unknown and will occur unexpectedly. Christ, who was once offered to bear sin, will appear a second time without sin to bring salvation to those who eagerly await Him. This promise encourages steadfast faithfulness, holding fast to what is received to ensure the believer’s reward is not lost.
